paite: TOUPA a kipan a Jeremiah kiang a thu hong tung in hichi in achi:
heading: Belvelpa Inn A Jeremiah
english: The word which came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, saying,

paite: "Thou inla, belvelmi inn ah hohsuk inla, huai ah ka thute ka hon theisak ding," achi hi.
english: Arise, and go down to the potter’s house, and there I will cause you to hear my words.

paite: Huchi in belvelmi inn ah ka hohsukta a, abel bawlna khawl ah nna asem hi.
english: Then I went down to the potter’s house, and behold, he was making a work on the wheels.

paite: Tung a bel abawl lai ahong hoih keileh belvelmi'n hoih asak bang in bel dang ding in abawl nawn zel hi.
english: When the vessel that he made of the clay was marred in the hand of the potter, he made it again another vessel, as seemed good to the potter to make it.

paite: Huchi in ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung nawn a,
english: Then the word of Yahweh came to me, saying,

paite: "Aw Israel inkote aw, hiai belvelmi hih bang in nou ka hon hihthei kei a hia? chih TOUPA thupawt ahi. Ngai dih ua, belvelmi khut a tungman bang lel in ka khut ah na om uhi, aw Israel inkote aw,"
english: House of Israel, can’t I do with you as this potter? says Yahweh. Behold, as the clay in the potter’s hand, so are you in my hand, house of Israel.

paite: Chik lai in leng nam hiamgam hiam tungtang thu ah, ka hon dokkhe ding, ka hon phel ding a, ka hon hihse ding, chi in na gen mah leng,
english: At what instant I shall speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to pluck up and to break down and to destroy it;

paite: Huai nam in atungthu ka gen ziak a athil hoih lou hih alehngatsan leh atung a thil hoih lou hih ka tup ka kikhelsak ding.
english: if that nation, concerning which I have spoken, turn from their evil, I will repent of the evil that I thought to do to them.

paite: Huan chik lai in leng nam hiamgam tungtang thu ah, ka hon bawl ding a, ka hon dingsak ding, chi a na gen hi leng zong,
english: At what instant I shall speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to build and to plant it;

paite: ka paukam suak ngaikhe lou a ka mitmuh a thil hoih lou ahihleh ama a ding in thil hoih hih ka tup ka kikhelsak sam ding.
english: if they do that which is evil in my sight, that they not obey my voice, then I will repent of the good, with which I said I would benefit them.

paite: Huaiziak in Judah mite leh Jerusalem a tengte kiang ah TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Ngai dih ua, na tung uah thil hoih lou ka ngaihtuah a, nou ka hon sawm lai na hi uh, michih in a-omdan hoih lou uh lehngatsan uhenla, na omdan uleh na thilhihte uh bawlpha un," va chi peuhmah in.
english: Now therefore, speak to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying, Thus says Yahweh: Behold, I frame evil against you, and devise a device against you: return you now everyone from his evil way, and amend your ways and your doings.

paite: Himahleh amau zaw, "Kilawm kei e! Koumau phasak bangbang in ka om ding ua, michih koumau lungtang gilou genhak bang zel in ka om ding uh," achi sek uhi.
english: But they say, It is in vain; for we will walk after our own devices, and we will do everyone after the stubbornness of his evil heart.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Namdangte dong him dih ua, hichibang mahmah kua'n athei a? Nungak siangthou Israel in thil lauhuai mahmah ahihta.
heading: Mipite'n TOUPA Anial Uh
english: Therefore thus says Yahweh: Ask now among the nations, who has heard such things; the virgin of Israel has done a very horrible thing.

paite: Lebanon vuk in amualvum anuse ngei a hia? Gamla a kipan a tui vot hong luangsukte akangtat ngei a hia?
english: Shall the snow of Lebanon fail from the rock of the field? Shall the cold waters that flow down from afar be dried up?

paite: Ka mite'n ahon mangngilh ua, bangmah lou phet kiang ah gimlim ahal ua, huaite'n atuma lam lampi ua kipan akisuisak a, lampi pen hilou lamkhem lam azui uh;
english: For my people have forgotten me, they have burned incense to false gods; and they have been made to stumble in their ways, in the ancient paths, to walk in byways, in a way not built up;

paite: agam uh hihsiatgawp ahi dia, tangtawn a enghou ding; kivialleh min lamdang sa in alu uh asing ding ua.
english: to make their land an astonishment, and a perpetual hissing; everyone who passes thereby shall be astonished, and shake his head.

paite: Suahlam huihpi bang in melma ma ah ka thehzak ding, avangtah ni un ka mel hilou, ka dek ka musak ding hi.
english: I will scatter them as with an east wind before the enemy; I will show them the back, and not the face, in the day of their calamity.

paite: Huan amau, "Kisa un, Jeremiah i sawm ding uh, siampu a kipan dan adai kei ding a, mipil a kipan thudot adai sam kei ding, zawlnei a kipan thu adai kei ding hi. Kisa un, i gensegawp ding ua, athu i limsak kei ding," achi uhi.
heading: Jeremiah Kalh A Doudalna
english: Then they said, Come, and let us devise devices against Jeremiah; for the law shall not perish from the priest, nor counsel from the wise, nor the word from the prophet. Come, and let us strike him with the tongue, and let us not give heed to any of his words.

paite: Hon limsak inla, aw TOUPA ka hon ngetna thu limsak in.
english: Give heed to me, Yahweh, and listen to the voice of those who contend with me.

paite: Thil hoih a gilou dit ahi dia hia? Amau lah ka kha a ding in kokhuk atou ngal ua. Amau a kipan a na hehna heimang ding leh amau a dia thil hoih gen ding a na ma a ka din sek theigige in.
english: Shall evil be recompensed for good? for they have dug a pit for my soul. Remember how I stood before you to speak good for them, to turn away your wrath from them.

paite: Huchi in atate uh kialpi kiang ah pekhia inla, namsau hatna kiang ah pia in; huan azite uh ta nei lou in, meithai uhen; apasalte uh hipi in si uhenla, atangvalte uh leng kidouna ah namsau in si uhen.
english: Therefore deliver up their children to the famine, and give them over to the power of the sword; and let their wives become childless, and widows; and let their men be slain of death, and their young men struck of the sword in battle.

paite: Sim mite akiang uh na tunsak guih lai in a-inn ua kipan kap husa thangkhia hen; kei a ding in kokhuk atou ngal ua, ka khe awkna ding in thang akam uhi.
english: Let a cry be heard from their houses, when you shall bring a troop suddenly on them; for they have dug a pit to take me, and hid snares for my feet.

paite: Himahleh nang, aw TOUPA kei hon that ding a ahon sawmna tengteng uh na thei hi; athulimlouhna uh ngaidam ke'nla, na mitmuh in akhelhna uh thaimang sam ke'n. Na ma ah kipuk uhenla, na heh ni in amaute soisa in.
english: Yet, Yahweh, you know all their counsel against me to kill me; don’t forgive their iniquity, neither blot out their sin from your sight; but let them be overthrown before you; deal you with them in the time of your anger.
